sentences.en: The 99PI team reads a lot.

sentences.en: And my relationship to this book is actually really connected to my work on this show.

sentences.en: So one thing I love about being a producer is that there's so many different phases of a production process, right?

sentences.en: There's the pitching, the researching, interviewing, writing, scoring.

sentences.en: The hardest phase for me is that brief window of time when I've submitted a first draft to an editor
sentences.zh: 对我来说最难的阶段是把初稿交给编辑后的那段短暂时间，

sentences.zh: 这在那个特定的时间段里，无意中变成了一种仪式。

sentences.en: I'll hand in a script, close my laptop, and I'll pickle something.

sentences.zh: 这就像是一种分散注意力的机制，让我不再为编辑对稿子的反应而焦虑。

sentences.en: And maybe it's because my first story was during peak pandemic and everyone was talking about fermentation.

sentences.en: But I just needed something to do with my hands.
